statement: The projectors PB, PX and the cluster logarithm LX have holomorphic coefficient germs through y = 0. Their Taylor expansions at y = 0 satisfy PF = SW ΠF S−1 W (F = B, X), LX = SW Ld,XS−1 W , (6.13) where Ld,X is the logarithm of KXEz on the X summand, extended by zero on B. Moreover, TaPB is divisible by y coefficientwise in z and base degree. Set e TB = y−1 TaPB. (6.14) 28 It has holomorphic coefficient germs through y = 0. Its nonzero spectral block at y = z = Q>0 = 0 has eigenvalue (−λ)−r, with possible nilpotent part, and its complementary block is zero. If KB is its supported logarithm on the nonzero block, then, on a punctured sector in y, one can choose the B-branch logarithm as LB = (log y)PB + KB. (6.15) The coefficients of KB are holomorphic through y = 0. Its Taylor expansion, and hence (6.15), obeys the same conjugation by SW as in (6.13), with the corresponding fixed-block operators in the descendant frame.
